original_sql:
SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, o.total_amount
FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= TO_DATE('2024-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND c.region = 'DAEGU'
